title: Financing: equity ratio and development
statement: Non-financial firms in more developed countries have a lower equity ratio.
effect_unit: pp equity ratio per +1 SD development
notes: Primary: +1 SD development → -0.29 pp equity ratio (typical 44%), wild p = 0.702, 34 countries, 9,051 company-years.
Robustness: predicted sign in 100% of seven samples. ESEF replication: +0.69 pp (wild p = 0.838), opposite direction.
Outcomes with q < 0.10 among the six: net margin (pp) (-3.64), operating margin (pp) (-3.55), return on equity (pp) (-2.41), loss-making firm-years (%) (+3.40).
